title: Yara and the Songbook
author: T. M. Halloran
blurb: Mara Pemberton, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
